name: Enhance Mind
body:
Design revelation; Level 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The target’s mind is enhanced, making it smarter, more clever, or more charismatic. This functions as your choice of either eagle’s splendor, fox’s cunning, or owl’s wisdom, except as noted above.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, you can grant the enhancement bonus to an additional ability score.
